concepts.def: Tech vocabulary: l'ordinateur (computer), le portable (mobile/laptop), la tablette, les réseaux sociaux (social networks).
Internet verbs: surfer sur internet, télécharger (download), tchatter (to chat), envoyer un mail.
Discussing pros/cons: 'L'avantage, c'est que...', 'L'inconvénient, c'est que...'. Key for GCSE essays.
Pouvoir (can), devoir (must), vouloir (want) + infinitive: 'On peut communiquer', 'Il faut faire attention'.
ne...pas (not), ne...jamais (never), ne...rien (nothing), ne...personne (nobody). Both parts sandwich the verb.
Le cyberharcèlement: harceler (to bully), une victime, dangereux/dangereuse. Common GCSE social issue.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 4: Media and Technology — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 4: Media and Technology brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 4: Media and Technology.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence means 'I never use Facebook'?
options: Je n'utilise jamais Facebook.
Je n'utilise pas jamais Facebook.
Je utilise jamais Facebook.
Je n'utilise rien Facebook.
to download
to upload only
to delete
to send a text

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am using my phone right now' (emphasising the action is in progress)?
options: Je suis en train d'utiliser mon portable.
Je vais utiliser mon portable.
Je suis utilisant mon portable.
Récemment, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'Currently, I am using social media' in French?
options: Actually, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Récemment, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Actuellement, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Je vais utiliser mon portable.

mcqs.q: Where does 'petit' usually go in relation to its noun?
options: Before the noun (un petit garçon).
After the noun like most French adjectives.
Either position with the same meaning.
Je vais utiliser mon portable.
